acquireRequires: no unexpired lease held by another owner
future-dated current lease blocks all acquisition until its acquired_at is reached or authoritative state is reconciled
fresh resource-safety admission equal to literal boolean true
Windows-main/H3 split-brain fence equal to literal boolean true
releaseRequires: archive the released request nonce into terminal history atomically
replayProtection: retain terminal request nonces authoritatively after release and expiry
active identical request is idempotent and returns the same lease
terminal or expired identical request nonce cannot mint a new lease
replacement acquire archives the expired current nonce before creating a new lease
persistedStateRequires: current lease record plus terminal nonce ledger persisted atomically
terminal nonce ledger entries must match the nonce contract
current request nonce must not already be terminal
persistedRecordRequires: timezone-aware acquired/expires timestamps normalized to UTC for comparison
acquired_at must be less than or equal to deployment-check time before the lease can be active
deployValidationRequires: fresh resource-safety admission equal to literal boolean true
fresh Windows-main/H3 split-brain fence equal to literal boolean true
failClosedOn: current lease acquired_at is in the future relative to the acquisition clock
integrationRequirement: Persist and arbitrate atomically inside the authoritative Control Hub/PostgreSQL transaction boundary before production use.
